why_this_model: The selected next action is a focused report-only metric/test/docs change with no DB, daemon, registry, model, promotion, or betting mutation.
worker_decision_limit: Workers may gather evidence or propose bounded tests, but the main agent keeps final decision authority.
lower_tier_decision_limit: Do not let a small worker choose runtime, DB, training, promotion, push, or betting actions.
root_problem: The accuracy denominator is blocked mostly by official-result completeness, but scorecard skip reasons currently collapse distinct official-result next actions into one broad bucket.
overfitting_assessment: Proceeding with one parser or one race would overfit. The selected change improves class-level routing across the full inventory denominator.
report_loop_assessment: This is only acceptable because it changes the existing packet used to choose the next implementation class and includes a fresh full report-only validation run.
broad_progress_assessment: The change makes production-readiness progress by turning a broad 667-race official-result skip bucket into actionable repair classes.
class_based_approach: Use race-level recommended_next_action to classify skipped scorecard races by append backlog, result capture, runner-set/identity repair, strict-odds collection, and strict-odds runner repair.
production_readiness_value: High for planning the next coverage repair; no direct model-quality or runtime-append change.

minority_objection.objection: A report-only taxonomy does not itself add evaluation races.
minority_objection.resolution: Accepted. The change is bounded to one session because it prevents another narrow repair loop and must be followed by an implementation against the highest-count class.

selected_next_goal: Extend the race evidence inventory scorecard metrics with actionable gap reason counts tied to recommended_next_action, add focused tests/docs, and run a fresh report-only inventory packet.
